patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Apollo.io and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Apollo.io only if use-case priority is prospecting and Kaspr is secondary for that motion. Choose Kaspr only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo ann” rather than Apollo.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Apollo.io leans email-outreach; Kaspr leans data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Apollo.io and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Workflow coverage skew: Apollo.io-leaning email-outreach vs Kaspr-leaning data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: Apollo.io — Not a pure CRM replacement for pipeline-first teams — deals are secondary to data/engagement.; Kaspr — LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies.

Limitations — Apollo.io: Not a pure CRM replacement for pipeline-first teams — deals are secondary to data/engagement.; Credits and record-selection limits govern data usage; Unlimited plans subject to fair-use policy.; Kaspr: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Native email outreach/sequencing depth is limited versus engagement platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Apollo.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a pure CRM replacement for pipeline-first teams — deals are secondary to data/engagement. · Kaspr is a poor fit when that limitation bites: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
